about: The most each perf-* scenario's steps may take (ms), by platform (linux, darwin, win32), judged on the median of the scenario's own repeats (lib/budgets.mjs; perf-compare.mjs --budgets). Each budget is 1.5 times the slowest of three runs' medians (measured), rounded up to 10 ms, and never under that median plus two frames (34 ms), so a step of a few ms isn't failed by one late frame. E2E_BUDGET_SCALE multiplies them all, for a slower computer than the one they were set on.

linux.machine: AMD Ryzen 9 5950X (32 threads), Debian 13 in a container, WebKitGTK 2.54, Xvfb 1400x900 with openbox, no GPU (llvmpipe, lavapipe)
